newsitem.title: USA: Molten Metal Q4 shr loss $2.24 with charge.
newsitem.headline: Molten Metal Q4 shr loss $2.24 with charge.

text.p: Molten Metal Technology Inc. on Thursday announced losses, including certain adjustments and non-recurring charges, of $2.24 per share for the fourth quarter, and $2.62 per share for the full year 1996.
The company said the losses for the year are primarily due to its M4 joint venture with Lockheed Martin and its expenditures in research and development.
Molten Metal reiterated that both it and Lockheed Martin are restructuring their relationship in the joint venture.
Motel Metal said the fourth quarter results include an equity loss of $37.1 million.
"This loss was due largely to a one-time non-cash charge related to a write down of M4 assets triggered by the pending restructuring," it said.
No other Molten Metal long-lived assets were impaired, it said.
The company said its results for 1996 also included a restatement of earnings for the second and third quarters of 1996. The restatement reflects disputed receivables in the joint venture, it said.

Molten Metal Technology, based ion Waltham, Mass. is an environmental technology company commercializing pollution prevention and waste recycling methods that are applicable to a wide variety of hazardous, non-hazardous, and radioactive wastes.
